title: E2E.Test.PAR2.Describes.Unposted.2026-TESTGRP
description: PAR2 describes only unposted tinder.bin and cannot reconstruct it. An unrelated XZ preserves its magic but has an invalid stream-header checksum, so recognition succeeds and decoding fails before producing usable bytes. The result must be Failed with a Repair reason, retaining only the exact posted files and ownership marker.
